request.query: Exponential absorption of factorial polynomial coefficient bound under a logarithmic lower bound

items.name: Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp
items.type: ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → ∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n / ↑n.factorial ≤ Real.exp x

items.name: Nat.eventually_pow_lt_factorial_sub
items.type: ∀ (c d : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, c ^ n < (n - d).factorial

items.name: Nat.factorization_factorial
items.type: ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → ∀ {n b : ℕ}, Nat.log p n < b → n.factorial.factorization p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i

items.name: Nat.Prime.emultiplicity_factorial
items.type: ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → ∀ {n b : ℕ}, Nat.log p n < b → emultiplicity p n.factorial = ↑(∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i)

items.name: isLittleO_exp_mul_rpow_of_lt
items.type: ∀ (k : ℝ) {a b : ℝ}, a < b → (fun t => Real.exp (a * t) * t ^ k) =o[Filter.atTop] fun t => Real.exp (b * t)
